title: GEMglBlendEquation
description: specify the equation used for both the RGB blend equation and the Alpha blend equation

messages.description: specifies how source and destination colors are combined

arguments.description: specifies how source and destination colors are combined

body: [GEMglBlendEquation] calls glBlendEquation() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. GL constants are numbers here: [GLdefine] turns a name like GL_LINES into its value. See glBlendEquation in the OpenGL reference.
